newsitem.title: india: India boat capsizes, 14 believed drowned.
newsitem.headline: India boat capsizes, 14 believed drowned.

text.p: At least 14 people were believed drowned in India on Friday after a boat capsized in the eastern state of Bihar, a senior official said.

R.L. Prasad, the top civil servant in Khagaria, scene of the incident 180 km (112 miles) from the state capital Patna, told Reuters 14 people were thought to have died when the boat with 60 passengers capsized in the Bagmati river.
Earlier the United News of India (UNI) news agency had said 54 people had apparently drowned.
"The body of one woman has been recovered so far and search operations are on for the others," Prasad said.
He said efforts to find the missing were under way.
Prasad said it was a routine river trip for villagers but heavy rains caused the accident.
